source_scope: Round 73: printed Chinese Chapters 1142–1151. Bqquge primary text was read through each visible continuation; Bq8xsw independently cross-checks chapter titles/order. Vietnamese Cơm Nguội, Hắc Hoàng Đại Đế, and Xa Lộ Sách chapter/catalog pages were compared by visible titles and story anchors; chapter segmentation/numbering diverges. Gated chapter bodies were not used for reward quantities.

confirmed_outcomes.event: Xia Yanni completes Legendary breakthrough into True Four-Symbol Dragon Lord; four dragon-form skill trees and Divine Power 0/1000 unlock. No new item receipt.

Dragon-descended caravan opens a Dragon-Coin-only shop. Listed offers include random rune/coin bags, cosmetic wings/scrolls, mount eggs and one unknown dragon egg for 1,000,000 coins. The egg is listed, not purchased. Chocobo race host sells/rents mounts; top-three race prizes and a 5% prize-pool host share are established in the proposed Starfire venue agreement.
Daily Chocobo race promotion is announced. Starfire guild upgrades begin.

As first leader to raise a guild through levels 11–20, Cao Xing receives 1.5m prestige, eight random Epic Guild Treasure Chests, one random Legendary Guild Treasure Chest, and one War God Contract Drum (semi-artifact). Eight Epic chests are opened; four names are visible, remainder omitted. Legendary chest produces Saint Crusader Shield Wall. Guild reaches level 20 with 3,100 member capacity and +59% base stats/+59% critical chance.
Dragon Combat Power Test: one 60-second attempt per survivor per day, max ten simultaneous contestants; Orange-grade+ skills and equipment abilities prohibited; dummy armor scales to level.

Test reward ladder is printed from E to SSS and rewards Dragon Coins/chests; keeping top 100 through event end yields a separate mystery prize. Cao Xing and four allies use bound SSS/SS/S reward chests.
Test board: Cao Xing 5,329.42bn SSS; Tong Chuchu 3,141.38bn SSS; Liu Muxue 1,842.47bn SS; Baizhi 342.31bn S; Xia Yanni 315.24bn S.

Bound chests are opened. Cao's Bright-Moon outputs include Millennium Treant Heart and named gear/materials; Tong Chuchu's Bright-Moon chest yields War Lord Core Breastplate plus named items, and she binds the breastplate. Two Legendary Earth-form weapons are assigned to Xia Yanni. Two Red Sky chests open in the next chapter.

Cao's Red Sky Chest yields Ice Core Divine Fire and three named materials; fire plus 200 Divine Power Fragments transfer to Baizhi. Tong Chuchu's Red Sky Chest gives a demigod missile blueprint and named materials. Arena rules normalize avatars to level 100 and a standard set; solo/team daily caps, Glory scoring, streak bonuses, rank thresholds and rewards are specified.

Cao Xing wins his first solo arena match for 1 Glory Point. His Eternal Force talent makes Ice Spirit Possession permanent on the standardized avatar, and Crystal Control/Ice Crystal's Wrath remain active despite the arena's skill restrictions.

unresolved_conflicts: Cơm Nguội and Hắc Hoàng Vietnamese Ch1142 both show the heading 'Pháp bào cấp Thần Khí, trời đất biến chuyển dữ dội!', while Chinese printed Ch1142/Bq8xsw title is 'Four-Symbol Dragon Lord, versatile Dragon Soul Envoy'. Xa Lộ Sách's segmented Ch1142 title is 'Legendary weapon enhancement' and is app-gated. Do not map these chapters by number.
Cơm Nguội and Hắc Hoàng chapter bodies are login-gated; Xa Lộ Sách only shows a short app-gated preview. Vietnamese title data is for edition alignment only.
Eight Epic guild chest outputs are not fully enumerated in the visible text; only four item names are retained.
Random treasure chest results in Chapters 1145 and 1149–1150 are observed one-time outcomes. They do not define general chest drop tables.
Some Bright-Moon chest output items are pooled across participants; only the explicitly attributed Tong Chuchu breastplate and Xia Yanni weapon assignment are treated as named allocations.
The 5% Chocobo pool share is accepted as a proposed operating contract; downstream bet payout percentages are unspecified.
Guild upgrade aggregate costs from levels 11 to 20 are not given completely and are not reconstructed.
